api_key.description: Momento disposable token or legacy API key. May also be provided via MOMENTO_API_KEY environment variable. Do NOT set the MOMENTO_ENDPOINT environment variable if you are using a disposable token or legacy API key.

v2_api_endpoint.description: Momento API Endpoint. May also be provided via MOMENTO_ENDPOINT environment variable alongside the MOMENTO_API_KEY environment variable containing a V2 API key.

v2_api_key.description: Momento V2 API Key. May also be provided via MOMENTO_API_KEY environment variable alongside the MOMENTO_ENDPOINT environment variable.

iam_role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Momento will assume to write logs.

log_group_name.description: The CloudWatch Log Group name where access logs will be delivered. The log group must already exist.

region.description: The AWS region where the CloudWatch log group is located.

access_logging_config.description: Optional configuration for access logging through CloudWatch.

id.description: The ID of the Object Store.

iam_role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Momento will assume to export metrics.

region.description: The AWS region where the metrics will be exported to.

metrics_config.description: Optional configuration for exporting CloudWatch metrics.

per_router_throttling_limits.description: The per-router-node throttling limits (ceiling of aggregate limits divided by router_count) sent to the Momento API.

router_count.description: The number of Momento router nodes backing this object store, computed from the /endpoints API.

s3_bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket for the Object Store.

s3_iam_role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Momento will assume to access your S3 bucket.

s3_prefix.description: Optional prefix path within the S3 bucket.

read_bytes_per_second.description: The maximum read throughput (bytes per second) that Momento will accept for this object store across all routers. This is used to prevent overwhelming the Object Store with requests. If not set, Momento will use a default limit.

read_operations_per_second.description: The maximum number of read requests per second that Momento will accept for this object store across all routers. This is used to prevent overwhelming the Object Store with requests. If not set, Momento will use a default limit.

write_bytes_per_second.description: The maximum write throughput (bytes per second) that Momento will accept for this object store across all routers. This is used to prevent overwhelming the Object Store with requests. If not set, Momento will use a default limit.

write_operations_per_second.description: The maximum number of write requests per second that Momento will accept for this object store across all routers. This is used to prevent overwhelming the Object Store with requests. If not set, Momento will use a default limit.

throttling_limits.description: Optional configuration for request throttling limits.

valkey_cluster_name.description: The name of the Momento Valkey Cluster to use for automatic caching.

enforce_shard_multi_az.description: Whether to enforce multi-AZ placement for shards.

id.description: The ID of the Valkey Cluster.

node_instance_type.description: The instance type for nodes in the Valkey Cluster. Please refer to https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/CacheNodes.SupportedTypes.html for supported instance types.

replication_factor.description: The number of replicas per shard.

availability_zone.description: The availability zone for the primary node.

replica_availability_zones.description: The availability zones for replica nodes.

shard_placements.description: Optional explicit placement configuration for shards. If not specified, placements are determined automatically.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

delete.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

update.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

block.description: A list of Momento serverless caches.
